slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Dialogue cleanup fixes location audio before anyone else hears it.
Noise reduction is not optional on client work.
Learn a noise profile from a room-tone snippet in RX or Fairlight.
De-plosive and de-ess lightly—over-processing sounds robotic.

slides.heading: NOISE PROFILE
slides.caption: Fix dialogue before you mix music.

slides.heading: WORKFLOW
steps: Learn noise profile from room tone.
Keep unprocessed backups on muted tracks.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Process a short section first—ears fatigue on long passes.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Heavy NR that turns voices into underwater radio.
